slide_dna.title: Data protection is in our DNA
slide_dna.subtitle: Just look at how we do website analytics: no cookies, no tracking pixels, no cross-site identifiers. We count page visits via a daily-rotating salt — impossible to follow visitors across days.
slide_dna.step2_lead: Server hashes your IP with a
slide_dna.note: The salt rotates every 24 hours via an automated database function — making it impossible to identify the same visitor across different days. This architecture falls outside the cookie-consent requirements of ePrivacy Art 5(3) and has been recognised by CNIL as consent-free.

slide_arch.title: How your data flows through our systems
slide_arch.subtitle: The main flow runs from your browser → Supabase Edge in Frankfurt → encrypted in the EU. Operator execution (conversations, advice, AI work) runs via a separate, explicit-consent route through the Regen team member.

slide_shield.title: Help us protect you against AI with an alias
slide_shield.subtitle: In all AI-derived documentation (transcripts, summaries, working files) we refer to you via an alias. Should there ever be a data leak in such a file, your real name cannot be tied to this interaction — an extra layer of privacy on top of the legal liability that of course remains. Your email address and public company name do stay visible to AI, because operational communication cannot work otherwise.
slide_shield.caption: Only your name is replaced with an alias. Email and public company details stay visible (without them AI cannot help with practical questions). Phone numbers are redacted.
slide_shield.picker_title: How should AI refer to you?

slide_subproc.title: Our sub-processors
slide_subproc.subtitle: The full list is in Annex A of the agreement below. Here one line per sub-processor — what they do, and whether they are in scope for this Engagement.

rows.supabase_purpose: Database + Edge Functions — where your data lives, encrypted at rest
rows.anthropic_purpose: LLM inference — only where you consent, with paste-alias-shield in front
rows.lettermint_purpose: Email delivery (this invitation, magic links, project correspondence)
rows.proton_purpose: Email hosting + working-file storage — end-to-end encrypted
rows.github_purpose: Static hosting of regenstudio.world — none of your data, public pages only
rows.exact_purpose: Bookkeeping — invoice-line metadata only (name + invoice address)
rows.ctf_purpose: Advisory cooperative — not engaged for your Engagement

slide_form.subtitle: Two things before we move to the legal text: your contact details as signatory, and whether AI may process your personal data (the alias choice was on the previous slide).

sign.heading: Signing
sign.confirm_text: I confirm I have read the Agreement above, am authorised to bind my organisation to it, and that my click on Sign carries the same legal weight as a handwritten signature (eIDAS Art 25(1)).
sign.sigpad_desc: A visual confirmation that will be included in the PDF. The legal anchor remains the SHA-256 hash + token hash + server-side signed_at — no image required.

after_sign.label: 💡 What happens after signing?
after_sign.step1: SES signature generated under eIDAS Art 25(1);
after_sign.step2: Full Agreement captured as an HTML snapshot (the legal integrity anchor — a PDF can be generated client-side from the same snapshot by either Party on request);
after_sign.step3: SHA-256 over the snapshot stored in dpa_signatures together with token hash, IP hash, UA hash, timestamp;
after_sign.step4: Tokenised download link to the signed snapshot is sent directly to your email address, with receipt link;
after_sign.step5: Relevant consent_records rows created; your alias (if any) registered.

modal.test_body: In production, the JSON payload below would be received by the Edge Function submit-dpa-signature after verifying the magic-link token, and a tokenised download link to the signed HTML snapshot would be sent immediately to the supplied email address with a receipt link. In this test no email is sent, no database row is created, no snapshot is stored.
